lead: An ion engine pushes very, very gently, but for years. In the end it can beat a powerful rocket.
try: Press Fly the spiral to watch a spacecraft slowly spiral outwards.
points: Its push is tiny, about the weight of a sheet of paper.
It uses its fuel about ten times more efficiently than a normal rocket engine, so a little fuel goes a very long way.
It is far too weak to lift off from Earth. It only works once you are already in space.
